caption: The drawing features the outline of a skirt with an overlaying apron. The skirt outline is rendered in thin, faint pencil lines. The apron is centered and filled with a pink hue, covered by a white crosshatched pattern. A portion of a brown pocket is visible on the left side of the apron. In the upper right section of the drawing, there is a smaller simplified outline showing the apron’s shape and waistband, also drawn in pencil, without any color fill. The background of the drawing is an off-white or light beige color. The artist's name, "MAE SALUVASY," is written in pencil in the lower right corner.
title: Apron
